name: livecheck-demo-agent-verify-then-confirm
description: Minimal hardcoded tool list for the paid Verify→Confirm demo. Follow docs/DEMO-AGENT-VERIFY-CONFIRM.md. Pay with purl or AgentCore payments. Actor ≠ verifier. MCP without a wallet returns 402.

tools.name: livecheck_verify
tools.description: Check whether a specific job, Shopify/HTML product, or eBay item URL is still live. Returns live|closed|unknown. $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. Unpaid → HTTP 402.

url.description: Absolute job, product, or eBay /itm/ URL

tools.name: confirm_lead_submit
tools.description: Independent check that a lead_submit side effect landed (actor ≠ verifier). Requires Level-2 evidence (ref/ticket/lead id). Thank-you copy alone is never confirmed. $0.10 USDC on Base via x402. Unpaid → HTTP 402.

url.description: Thank-you or result URL after lead submit

claim.description: Optional fingerprint / claim id from the actor

agentcore_bazaar.note: AgentCore buyers: add Coinbase x402 Bazaar Gateway target + payments plugin; search livecheck returns verify + confirm (+ confirm/order).
